articles.description: : Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis has ordered a comprehensive probe into alleged donation irregularities at the famous Siddhivinayak Temple in the city, directing officials to examine the shrine's records of the last five years, an official said on Saturday. The directive comes on the heels of allegations by Maharashtra Navnirman Sena chief Raj Thackeray claiming Rs 18 crore was siphoned off annually from the temple, prompting the arrest of nine employees and Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde's demand for independent inquiries. According to officials, Fadnavis ordered a probe after a delegation from the Siddhivinayak Temple Trust met him and presented a detailed account of the collections between 2023-2026. The chief minister has sought the probe report at the earliest, they said. Last month, Shinde had sought an independent inquiry and instructed officials to begin the process. articles.title: Supreme Court to hear plea against order upholding rejection of waqf suits for non-payment of court fees

articles.description: A bombshell CNN report claims U.S. Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff General Dan Caine has privately pushed senior officials to find an “off-ramp” from the war. The concerns reportedly come as Washington faces several major challenges—including the risk of Iranian retaliation, pressure on U.S. weapons stockpiles and growing fears that strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure could trigger an even wider regional conflict.

articles.title: ‘Wherever A Moscal Is Being Beaten...’: Polish President Uses Slur For Russians In Trump-Style Rant
articles.description: Polish president Karol Nawrocki has stoked a major row over his slur at Russia amid the Ukraine conflict. While marking the first anniversary of his inauguration, Nawrocki in his speech emphasised a "Poland First" agenda and reaffirmed support for Ukraine's defense against Russia. During his address, Nawrocki used the term "Moscal" to refer to Russians—a historical Slavic term meaning "Muscovite" that is widely regarded today in parts of Eastern Europe as an ethnic slur. His remarks have drawn attention for their strong rhetoric and nationalist tone. Nawrocki argued that it was in Poland's strategic interest for Ukraine to resist Russian forces while also insisting that Polish national interests must remain the government's top priority.

Booker questioned how someone who spent decades building a life in America could die after less than two months in immigration detention, sharply criticizing the country’s immigration system and raising concerns over conditions inside ICE facilities.

articles.title: Centre backs most of IT panel's suggestions to curb fake news
articles.description: The Centre accepted nine of twelve recommendations to curb fake news. Replies to three contentious issues, including defining fake news, were deferred. Measures accepted cover regulatory frameworks and media self-regulation. The government noted PIB Fact Check Unit's ongoing verification of misinformation. The committee sought updates on proposed amendments and media literacy initiatives.

articles.title: 'It's time for action...': Senate passes Graham Russia sanctions bill; Trump gets new tariff powers
articles.description: The U.S. Senate has passed a sweeping bipartisan Russia sanctions bill in an 86-11 vote, advancing one of the toughest measures yet aimed at increasing pressure on Moscow. The legislation, renamed in honor of the late Senator Lindsey Graham, would allow President Donald Trump to impose tariffs of up to 100% on major buyers of Russian oil and gas, target Russia's 'shadow fleet,' and extend sanctions on Iran.
